cases.name: preset settings example
cases.yaml:
# The preset settings example of plan 4.5.
version: 1
presets:
  - getter                    # default settings
  - noop:
      include_functions: true # also hide empty functions that are not methods
  - iferr:
      names: [err, "*Err"]    # also parseErr and similar names
      paths: ["internal/**"]  # limit this preset to some files

rules.description: Methods that only return a field of the receiver.
Methods that take no parameters, return nothing, and have an empty body.
`if err != nil` blocks that return the error unchanged.
